subject: Access controls kickoff — SSO/SCIM & IP allowlist
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@fastretail.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: infra@fastretail.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:43 -0800
Subject: Access controls: SSO/SCIM kickoff for FastRetail

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're ready to kick off implementation planning for FastRetail's Redwood deployment. Primary goals for this phase:
- SSO (SAML 2.0) with our identity provider (Okta)
- SCIM provisioning for user accounts and groups
- IP allowlist for backend API calls from our network
- Service account patterns for automation and org policy alignment

Key asks from our side before the kickoff meeting:
1) Recommended attribute mappings (email, displayName, department, role) and any required attributes from Redwood for auth/authorization.
2) An IP allowlist template we can paste into our firewall change request.
3) Best-practice naming for service accounts and suggested least-privilege scopes.

Can you propose a 60-minute slot for next week? Also copying our infra alias so they can provide CIDR ranges.

Thanks,
Alice Chen
Director, Platform Security
FastRetail Inc.
[Attachment: fastretail-security-eval.pdf (application/pdf)]

Alice — thanks for the clear list. 60 minutes should be plenty for the kickoff. Proposed slots:
- Wed 2026-12-02 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu 2026-12-03 13:00–14:00 PT

Attached are three artifacts to prep:
- redwood-sso-scim-checklist.xlsx (attribute mappings, SAML endpoints, SCIM provisioning options)

3) Network & IP allowlist cadence (10m)
4) Service accounts + org policy handoffs (10m)
5) Next actions & kickoff owners (10m)

Monica will lead the SAML mapping review and Jonas will cover service account guardrails. If that looks good, I’ll send a calendar invite for Wednesday.

Best,
Ben Carter

Redwood Inference

On Tue, Dec 1, 2026 at 11:04 AM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Attached are three artifacts to prep:
> - redwood-sso-scim-checklist.xlsx (attribute mappings, SAML endpoints, SCIM provisioning options)
>
Thanks, Ben — quick note on attributes before the call:
- Required for auth: email (userPrincipalName ok too), subjectId (we prefer immutable id from IdP).
- Authorization / role mapping: we recommend syncing a group claim (group names) and a custom attribute `redwood_role` if you have role data in Okta.
- SCIM: recommend group-based provisioning for staff + contractors; exclude service accounts from SCIM (we manage those manually).

Question for FastRetail infra: do you provision nested groups? If so, we need to discuss group flattening to avoid long sync times.

See the mapping tab in the attached checklist for a proposed default you can accept or tweak during the meeting.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success, Redwood Inference

From: infra@fastretail.com <infra@fastretail.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alice Chen <alice.chen@fastretail.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 08:22:30 -08:00
Subject: Re: Access controls: SSO/SCIM kickoff for FastRetail

Thanks for the materials. A few notes from the ops side:
- CIDR ranges: 52.34.128.0/24, 18.205.64.0/22 (will supply a full list in the kickoff).
- We maintain nested groups for permission inheritance; happy to discuss flattening options.
- For service accounts we want them to follow this pattern: `srvc-<team>-<purpose>-<env>` (e.g., srvc-payments-sync-prod).
- We raised a compliance item: need to ensure audit logs for SCIM provisioning events are retained 13 months. Is Redwood able to provide per-tenant provisioning logs?

Attached: fastretail-org-policies_v1.pdf (org policy excerpts)

—FastRetail DevOps

Appreciate the details — confirmed for Wednesday 2026-12-02 10:00 PT (calendar invite sent). Quick highlights / pre-kickoff asks so we make the 60 minutes productive:
Pre-kickoff deliverables (please upload to the shared Drive link before the meeting):
- Full CIDR list (infra) — paste into the IP-allowlist-template.csv

During the meeting we will:

- Decide SCIM group scope and deprovision policy (Monica + FastRetail)
- Lock in the IP allowlist CIDRs and the rollout window (Ben + infra)
- Agree on service account naming and RBAC pattern (Jonas + Tessa)

Next steps: I attached a one-page kickoff checklist (redwood-sso-scim-checklist.xlsx) with owners and the first three milestones. If there's no objections I'll keep the invite and we can run the agenda to the timebox.

Thanks all — looking forward to the call.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
